rider_term.value: Minimum 12 months (single and regular pay) or 60 months (limited pay); maximum 240 months. Within the base policy term.

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited (36 to 180 months) or regular pay (up to 240 months). Payment mode as the base plan. Total rider premium at most 100% of base plan premiums.
premium_paying_rules.quote: The total Rider Premium shall not exceed 100% of premiums

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 50,000. No maximum, subject to underwriting; not above the base product sum assured.
sum_assured_limits.quote: The Rider Sum Assured cannot be higher than Sum

premium_deduction.note: The brochure text read does not say whether the rider premium is separate or from units. The Accident Care rider says it is payable in addition to the base premium.
